window_feature: DSTE temporal max over real outputs, spatial max over all 50 tokens as recovered F0; F1 hidden mean over real outputs
clip_feature: arithmetic mean of window features, each window equal weight
padding_outputs: excluded from temporal max and hidden mean; repeated-pose inputs may still influence contextual tokens
folds: (subject-1)%5; train other four folds, selection/evaluation on held-out fold
claim: development validation-OOF, not unbiased nested or external generalization

training.loss: CE with train-fold-only inverse-sqrt class frequency divided by mean
training.shuffle: randperm generator seed+epoch shared between representations

newly_specified_not_recovered: sampling details inherited from ZS revision
